title: Towards Tracing Trustworthiness Dynamics: Revisiting Pre-training Period of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'trustworthiness' of LLMs, which is a core pillar of AI ethics. It specifically benchmarks five dimensions including 'fairness' and 'toxicity.' Within the fairness dimension, the study uses the StereoSet dataset to evaluate stereotypical biases related to religion. Furthermore, the entire paper is dedicated to evaluating and improving ethical model behaviors like reliability and safety.
